name: Torque
source:
Torque, the unofficial "[Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Baron_(VTM)]Baron[/url] of the Bronx" is a World War 2 veteran who was [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Embrace_(VTM)]Embraced[/url] into the [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Brujah]Brujah[/url] clan shortly after coming home from Europe. 

He rooted himself in the local [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Anarch]Anarch[/url] community, slowly becoming a trusted ally of many of his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Kindred_(VTM)]Kindred[/url] compatriots - but always remaining in Boss Callihan's shadow. 

Torque was patient, knowing that any action he took against the Baron of New York City would surely create an uphill struggle. The events of Operation Lights Out, and the loss of his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Childe]childe[/url] to what seemed, at best, Callihan's cowardice (and at worst an overt betrayal), embittered him - but also convinced him to make his move sooner rather than later.

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
